title: Coast Guard Medevacs Sailor Missing for More Than 60 Days
description:
A Coast Guard MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter crew medevacs a man from motor vessel Houston Express off the North Carolina coast Thursday, April 4, 2015.

The crew aboard Houston Express spotted the man on a disabled sailing vessel and took him aboard approximately 200 miles east of Cape Hatteras.

U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Elizabeth City
keywords: Air Station Elizabeth City, Portsmouth, Coast Guard rescue, angel, Mid-Atlantic, d5, missing sailor, North Carolina
